name: ui-data-grid
description: DataGrid — structured records grid rendering rows over configurable columns, with sort, select, and drag-reorder. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui data-grid pattern).

schema.name: ui-data-grid
schema.description: DataGrid — structured records grid rendering rows over configurable columns, with sort, select, and drag-reorder. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui data-grid pattern).

events.name: Data grid loaded

events.description: Selection change event name (emits UI:{selectionEvent} with { selectedIds: string[] })

events.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

events.name: View
events.description: User opened a record from the list.

dragGroup.label: Drag Group
dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field definitions for rendering each card. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

loadMoreEvent.label: Load More Event
loadMoreEvent.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

look.label: Look
look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

positionEvent.label: Position Event
positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

hasMore.label: Has More
hasMore.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

minCardWidth.label: Min Card Width
minCardWidth.description: Minimum card width in pixels (used when cols is not set, default 280)

cols.label: Cols
cols.description: Number of columns (uses auto-fit if omitted)

dndRoot.label: Dnd Root
dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

reorderEvent.label: Reorder Event
reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }

scrollX.label: Scroll X
scrollX.description: Lay items in a single horizontally-scrolling row (kanban columns) sized to `minCardWidth` instead of a wrapping grid.

selfFetch.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?
selfFetch.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Max items to show before 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (disabled).

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Alias for `fields` — the compiler emits `columns` for field defs.

dropEvent.label: Drop Event
dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

dndItemIdField.label: Dnd Item Id Field
dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

selectionEvent.label: Selection Event
selectionEvent.description: Selection change event name (emits UI:{selectionEvent} with { selectedIds: string[] })

sortable.label: Sortable
sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

accepts.label: Accepts
accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

imageField.label: Image Field
imageField.description: Entity field name containing an image URL for card thumbnails

maxInlineActions.label: Max Inline Actions
maxInlineActions.description: Max inline primary action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.
